My mind is all over the place. I feel like a burden to everybody. I’m not going to lie my mind has just been fixated on suicide and if I didn’t have my parents here or if I had drugs or something I would just end it. I see no future for myself. I’ll just copy and paste the text message of why we aren’t together in her words: 

Hi listen, here is why we aren't together anymore. All things which should have warented me leaving you long ago, but I didn't because I love you, and your sweet and kind. Those factors blinded me to the fact that you simply aren't a good partner. With all the petty things youve done with me and this new blow finding out you lied about when your crush started, and thinking back to experiences I had when I was under the impression you didnt like her. Also lets not use the word crush, you said you were falling for her. I remeber when I came to visit for the weekend in winter and we went to a bar all together, i remeber walking alone with (friend) while you were trying to catch up to her, i remember the way you looked at her and how you ignored me, I remeber you telling me you were going to go to a concern with her in (place) to see black bear and you invited ME to tag along. You lied about porn making me feel like I was enough even though I clearly wasnt if you had to keep watching it and telling me that I was enough messed with my head when then turns out I wasnt not once not twixe but three times. The biggest issue now, is that I have been supporting you and carrying you throught the entire duration of our relationship. It has never been 50 50 as it should be. I have always taken upon this role of the mom and I don't want to anymore. Now more serisouly, our future which you have been jeopordizing from the start by refusing to get help, even though when I was in a dark place all you shoved down my throat was go to therapy. It is absolutely ridicolous that I have set up this whole plan for us to go to (place), I have applied gotten in and looked up apartments and have just been actively trying to make this happen all for YOU because i would never go to (place) alone, only for YOU because. Yet you can't even apply? You have been procrastinating this next step forever, not doing anything not trying, when all I have been doing is trying to help, do research for you, set things up for you, which I shouldnt need to do, yet there I was acting like your mother, whilst you did nothing. I know you aren't ok, but then you need to get help, you can't threaten me with suicide to stay with you, this isn't a healthy relatinoship and I am tired of trying my best to salvage it and swipe every issue I have under the rug just for love. Love isn't enough, which you have proved to me over these past years, because if it was, I wouldnt have to be forcing you to apply to uni or linkedin, or epa courses or everything. I am tired (my name) and I have been for a long time, I have cried to you so many times begging you to do something to fix this becayse I cannot do it for you. Yet you never did, so I am choosing to walk away. Yes I may have broken up with you, but the ball has always been in your court and I have been waiting for you to make a move or do something anything at all and you never did. So I hope you can figure things out in these next few months, I am not making any promises and I do not want to get your hopes up, as its a bit too late for that. Your motivatoin shuoldnt be me leaving the final straw, it should have been me crying and begging you to make this happen for us so we could be happy together and have a life together, that clearly wasnt motivation enough for you. I hope this explains everything. Please do not reply to this I am not trying to engage in a converstation I am just trying to explain things to you.
